issues.problem: At step 40000 (a refine step: 40000 % 100 == 0, < 45000) clone/split/prune runs before the bake and before the checkpoint/validation/ss-eval. The evaluated splat set therefore contains freshly cloned/split children that no gradient step has seen (clones sit exactly on their parents, so identical network outputs are stacked and alpha is doubled), plus parents removed by split.
issues.evidence: Official train.py saves point_cloud and deform weights (saving_iterations) BEFORE the 'Densification' block of the same iteration and skips the optimizer step at the last iteration; the densify at 40000 is then discarded, so render.py evaluates the anchor set after the 39900 refine. Plugin runs step_post_backward(step=40000) then bake(). Stage 1 has the same issue and its final cloud also feeds stage 2.
issues.fix: Skip refinement at the final step: set refine_stop_iter to 40000 for both stages (gsplat returns for step >= refine_stop_iter, so 39900 is the last refine, matching the official saved model), or skip step_post_backward when step == total_steps and bake first. Update test_splatfields.py:77 and the schedule probes.

issues.problem: 'No opacity reset' holds only because gsplat 1.5.3 has the precedence bug `if step % self.reset_every == 0 & step > 0` (parses as a chained comparison against `0 & step`, always False). reset_every must stay 3000 because gsplat's too-big pruning is gated on step > reset_every (official: iteration > opacity_reset_interval); the unused value is misleading and a gsplat upgrade would silently add resets.
issues.evidence: python: 3000 % 3000 == 0 & 3000 > 0 -> False. The 'schedule' and 'stage1-schedule' probes do detect a reset at 3000 (they fail on a fix of gsplat), so this is covered but fragile.
issues.fix: Comment the coupling in BASE and pin gsplat==1.5.3 in pyproject; keep the probes.

issues.problem: If ss-train --steps != 40000 the bake never happens (steps<40000) or happens mid-run (>40000), silently leaving garbage base fields (const opacity 0.1, black sh0) in the checkpoint that ss-eval renders. Only a note in bench_request.json guards this.
issues.evidence: density has no access to runtime steps; bake keyed only on cfg total_steps.
issues.fix: Fail loudly: in ss-eval-visible state/checkpoint mark baked flag, or have the renderer raise when the net is absent and the density state says not baked; or verify steps in bench wrapper.

fidelity_gaps_confirmed: Protocol verified against official code: KMeans(n, random_state=0) on the 100 scaled train camera centres only, sklearn 1.0.2 (re-run reproduces views.json); test = all 200 transforms_test views; 800x800 (official max_resolution 800 does not downscale); white background composite trunc(255*...); masks = PNG alpha (>0 for hull); hull 256^3 in [-1,1]^3 with official projection, 100k (official hull branch ignores max_num_pts 300000); val = 8 transforms_val views, never used for selection or training.

Camera: plugin uses an orthonormal c2w with scaled translation; the official view matrix carries a 1/ws scale on R, but J*W (and hence the 2D covariance and projection) is identical; only the 0.01 near plane differs by ws (negligible).

Stage 1: mask 0.1, densify through the whole run, no reset, LRs (means 8e-4->8e-6 over 30k then held, scales 0.005, quats 0.001, opa 0.05, sh 0.0025, shN/20), 3-NN init scales, opacity 0.1, extent = 1.1*max cam dist all match official, except the last-step densify.

Stage 2 from build_stage2.sh/make_stage2.py: stage-1 checkpoint means, official hull filter on train masks, random <=100k, base scales recomputed by 3-NN on the new cloud (as official create_from_pcd); anchors get no gradient (detach); official SplatFields stage run omits --is_static but n_frames=0 so the static branch is identical.
paper_results.json matches the LaTeX: Table 2 / supp C1 PSNR and C2 SSIM at 6 views (SplatFields 22.26/0.8662, 3DGS 20.62/0.8356, all 8 per-scene values) and 12 views; 'toy' = lego.
summary: Protocol, stage-1 recipe, stage-2 architecture/LRs/losses and paper_results.json are faithful to the official code and tables. One major deviation: a clone/split/prune refine runs at step 40000 before the bake/eval (official saves before densifying and discards it), so evaluated splats include untrained duplicates; fix by stopping refinement at 40000 (refine_stop_iter) in both stages. Remaining items are minor (fragile no-reset dependence on a gsplat bug, silent no-bake if steps != 40000, stale plan.md, 3-scene mean not comparable to paper 8-scene mean).
